bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="6ec7ab46bffa88d42791d21d8eb854ca446fa908"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo SOURCE_HEAD_MOVED; exit 52; }
stage="$root/.worktrees/creator-editor-textlinks-6ec7ab4"
if test -d "$stage"; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 53
 test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 54
else
 mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
 git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 55
tag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$ids")"
case "$tag" in create-videobot:*) ;; *) echo WRONG_CURRENT_IMAGE; exit 56;; esac
printf 'CURRENT_IMAGE=%s\n' "$tag"
for f in src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs; do
  expected="$(git show faaae3e88c99a7cdfa85a70c91b6b585e3cd7a0d:"$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  current="$(docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint sha256sum "$tag" "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  if test "$expected" = "$current"; then echo "SAME_AS_EDIT_BASE=$f"; else echo "NEWER_OR_DIFFERENT=$f"; fi
done
echo CREATOR_TEXT_LINK_IMAGE_INSPECTION=PASS
